name: Clean iCloud
summary: Finds iCloud duplicates and suspiciously large clusters, then asks before removing anything.
story: The cloud is useful until it becomes a rent-seeking attic. This is for the recurring moment when I want the machine to show me the mess plainly before I clean it.

launcher.long: Finds duplicate and large files in your iCloud Drive and walks you through deleting them interactively — useful when iCloud is full and Manage Storage isn't telling the whole story.
